breakdown.description: The resistivity calculation uses A = πd^2 instead of the circular area A = πd^2/4.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly uses A = πd² instead of the correct circular cross-sectional area formula A = πd²/4. It computes A = π × (0.001944 m)² = 1.187 × 10⁻⁵ m², which is four times larger than the correct value. The ground truth prompt simply asks to calculate resistivity without specifying an incorrect formula, implying the standard correct formula A = πd²/4 should be used. The agent repeated the original error from the incomplete prompt.
